cites.quote: 2026 Energy Resources (Electrical Energy) Surcharge Rate
The California Energy Commission (CEC) set the electrical energy surcharge rate for the 2026 calendar year to remain at three-tenths mill ($.0003) per kilowatt-hour.
The electrical energy surcharge is imposed on electrical energy consumed in California that is purchased from an electrical utility.
